Game Overview

Hamburger Run puts players into a casual experience centered on dodge ravenous customers as a runaway burger, gathering tasty ingredients on the go. Navigate frantic chases, using quick reflexes to avoid capture while building the ultimate escape sandwich. How long can you stay free in this deliciously fun adventure?

How to Play

Hamburger Run keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Dodge ravenous customers as a runaway burger, gathering tasty ingredients on the go.
